responsibility: Describes the standard include-directory roles used by GCC and G++ on native and cross configurations. It explains the purpose of directories such as @code{GCC_INCLUDE_DIR}, @code{GPLUSPLUS_INCLUDE_DIR}, @code{LOCAL_INCLUDE_DIR}, @code{CROSS_INCLUDE_DIR}, and @code{TOOL_INCLUDE_DIR}, especially in relation to fixed headers and cross-toolchain system headers.
